# WaitTimer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date)

</div>


```blitzbasic
WaitTimer:Int32 timer:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `timer` | In | Int32 | required | The timer handle. |

**Returns:** The number of ticks since the last call, at least 1.

## Description

Waits for the next tick of a timer and returns how many ticks went by since the last call, which is 1 when your loop keeps up and more when it fell behind. Do not call it on a timer that is paused.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
timer = CreateTimer(100)
ticks = WaitTimer(timer)
Print ticks >= 1
FreeTimer timer
```

```text
1
```
